data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: will rat poison work on other animals? ASSISTANT:
No, rat poison will not work on other animals. It is specifically designed to kill rats and is not intended for use on other animals.

BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: If man developed from monkeys, why do we still have monkeys? ASSISTANT:
Man did not develop from monkeys; this is a myth. Man and monkeys share a common ancestor that existed millions of years ago.
